title: hymenocallis × festalis
intro: Hymenocallis × festalis, commonly known as the Minnow Head or the Spider Lily, is a hybrid plant species that belongs to the family Amaryllidaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as skin conditions like eczema and wounds due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hymenocallis × festalis include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and coughs, and its anti-inflammatory properties, which reduce inflammation and promote healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, saponins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
